documentation.content: Cloud Run Job `__JOB__` failed. Exit 3 = exports were published but a collector failed (often blocked from GCP IPs); any other code = the API still serves the previous export. Runbook: README.md (Troubleshooting)

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "__JOB__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
